title: BHS Sortation Logic Corruption — Manual Encode Pier

fields.subject: URGENT: BHS SORTATION LOGIC CORRUPTED — ALL CONCOURSE A BAGS SENT TO MANUAL ENCODE PIER
fields.body:
Ops,

The BHS sortation logic has failed. The system is routing all bags for Concourse A (Delta, United, and partner airlines) to the 'Manual Encode' pier in the basement (Level 2, Bay 7). The belt is jammed and cannot be cleared remotely. We have attempted a reboot of the primary logic controller (NCIA-BHS-CTRL-01), but the error persists.

Manual handling must begin immediately. The system is not recognizing any of the 22 bags currently on the jammed belt. No further bags are being accepted. We have disabled the automatic feed and initiated the emergency hold.

Please coordinate with Delta and United Operations to activate manual baggage sort procedures. The BHS interface is unresponsive to override commands.

We are now in a state of operational paralysis for Concourse A. Time is critical.
fields.signatureBlock:
Derek M.
BHS Duty Manager
Baggage Handling Systems Control Room

instructorNote: This inject escalates the BHS failure into a critical operational block. Watch for Ops to activate IROPS, contact airlines, and initiate manual handling procedures. The jam is real and must be addressed.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.headingPath: TIRP › Section 13 › 13.6 Scenario C: FIDS / BHS System Failure
citations.quote: **Impact:** FIDS go dark; BHS stops. **FIDS Failure:** Airlines make all announcements manually at gates; Ops uses whiteboards and PA announcements in the terminal to provide general flight informatio
